main_body: Stack of cheese wheels: one small wheel on top of two wider wheels, all in yellow tones
top_band: Upper wheel: light yellow #f4dd85 rows 4-5 (plus a #eac65a edge on row 3). Lower wheels: a single light row at row 10 (rows 9-10 at x=12). These are rims, not surfaces.
evidence: At x=8 the column runs: edge row 3, light rows 4-5, front face rows 6-8, dark line row 9, light row 10, front face rows 11-13, dark base row 14. Each wheel's top is only 1-2 rows, so it reads as a rim or lip. Each wheel is mostly a flat yellow front band with a dark line under it, so no wheel shows an elliptical top face like the green barrel in the guide. The drawing is a front elevation of stacked bands with only thin highlight rims on top.

style.evidence: The piece has only 4 distinct colours and a median of 4 colours per tile. The references have 38-40 distinct colours and a median of 17-20 per tile. The yellow ramp is just highlight, mid and a dark brown line, with no grain, rind texture or per-wheel variation. The outline is a tinted brown (0% neutral), which is acceptable, but the shading is far shallower than the cheese stall reference.
